#+title: Blur API demo
#+author: koftamainee

* Initial images
[[file:DoNotOpen.jpg]]

[[file:DoNotOpen2.jpg]]

* Server Lifecycle
** Build Docker Image
#+begin_src bash :dir .. :results output
docker compose build > /dev/null 2>&1
echo "ok"
#+end_src

#+RESULTS:
: ok

** Launch Server
#+begin_src bash :dir .. :results output
docker compose up -d > /dev/null 2>&1
echo "ok"
#+end_src

#+RESULTS:
: ok

** Check Connection
#+begin_src bash :results output
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8080/healthz)
[ "$code" = "200" ] && echo "healthz: $code" || echo "unavailable"
#+end_src

#+RESULTS:
: unavailable

** Stop Server
#+begin_src bash :dir .. :results output
docker compose down > /dev/null 2>&1
curl -f -s http://localhost/8080/healthz || echo "ok"
#+end_src

#+RESULTS:
: ok


* Blur (sigma = 5.0)

#+begin_src bash :results output
curl -s -o blurred-v1.jpg -w "%{http_code}\n%{content_type}\n" \
  -F "sigma=5.0" \
  -F "image=@DoNotOpen.jpg" \
  http://localhost:8080/api/blur
#+end_src

#+RESULTS:
: 200
: image/jpeg

[[file:blurred-v1.jpg]]

* Blur (sigma = 20.0)

#+begin_src bash :results output
curl -s -o blurred-v2.jpg -w "%{http_code}\n%{content_type}\n" \
  -F "sigma=20.0" \
  -F "image=@DoNotOpen2.jpg" \
  http://localhost:8080/api/blur
#+end_src

#+RESULTS:
: 200
: image/jpeg

[[file:blurred-v2.jpg]]

* Errors

Without image and incorrect sigma

#+begin_src bash :results output
curl -s -w " -> %{http_code}\n" -F "sigma=2.0" http://localhost:8080/api/blur
curl -s -w " -> %{http_code}\n" -F "sigma=abc" -F "image=@DoNotOpen.jpg" http://localhost:8080/api/blur
curl -s -w " -> %{http_code}\n" -F "sigma=50" -F "image=@DoNotOpen.jpg" http://localhost:8080/api/blur
curl -s -w " -> %{http_code}\n" -F "sigma=-2.5" -F "image=@DoNotOpen.jpg" http://localhost:8080/api/blur
#+end_src

#+RESULTS:
: {"code":"BAD_REQUEST","error":"image file is required"} -> 400
: {"code":"BAD_REQUEST","error":"invalid sigma parameter"} -> 400
: {"code":"BAD_REQUEST","error":"sigma should be less or equal to 20.00"} -> 400
